text.en: One CORDIC step either adds the y value to x or subtracts it, and which one happens is chosen by the direction bit.
text.es: Un paso CORDIC o suma el valor de y a x o lo resta, y cuál de las dos ocurre lo decide el bit de dirección.

text.en: Use a conditional `… when dir = '1' else …` assignment; do the add and the subtract in signed arithmetic (`signed(x_in) ± signed(y_in)`) and cast each result back to `std_logic_vector`.
text.es: Usa una asignación condicional `… when dir = '1' else …`; haz la suma y la resta en aritmética con signo (`signed(x_in) ± signed(y_in)`) y convierte cada resultado de vuelta a `std_logic_vector`.

text.en:
Pick between the two with the direction bit.
```vhdl
x_out <= std_logic_vector(signed(x_in) + signed(y_in)) when dir = '1'
    else std_logic_vector(signed(x_in) - signed(y_in));
```
text.es:
Elige entre las dos con el bit de dirección.
```vhdl
x_out <= std_logic_vector(signed(x_in) + signed(y_in)) when dir = '1'
    else std_logic_vector(signed(x_in) - signed(y_in));
```
